rules.title: Limit on Charges at Commencement of Tenancy (Security Deposit Law)
rules.requirement: Landlords cannot require tenants to pay any amount beyond first month's rent, last month's rent, and a security deposit (or statutorily authorized fee-in-lieu) before a tenancy begins — this bars separate application or screening fees.
rules.key_value: No charges beyond first month, last month, security deposit (or authorized fee-in-lieu)
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to all residential tenancies in Massachusetts at or prior to commencement of tenancy.
rules.quoted_span: At or prior to the commencement of any tenancy, no lessor or agent of the lessor may require a tenant or prospective tenant to pay, to the lessor or to an agent of the lessor, any amount in excess of the following:

rules.title: Restriction on Finding Dwelling Accommodations for a Fee (Broker Licensing Requirement)
rules.requirement: Only a licensed real estate broker or salesperson may charge a fee to find rental housing for a prospective tenant; any such fee must be paid by the party (landlord or tenant) who actually engaged the broker.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to any person engaging in the business of finding dwelling accommodations for prospective tenants for a fee.
rules.quoted_span: No person shall engage in the business of finding dwelling accommodations for prospective tenants for a fee unless such person is a licensed broker or salesman as defined in section eighty-seven PP of chapter one hundred and twelve.
rules.conflict_note: Text amended effective August 1, 2025; earlier version (Section 87DDD1/2) effective until that date is substantively similar.
